svg.aria-label: wt demo: git checkout fails because the branch is checked out in another worktree; wt go opens that worktree; wt ls lists worktrees; wt finish refuses a staged docs file, then rebases onto origin/develop.

g.text: The problem: a branch can be checked out in only one place
wt go: land in the worktree that holds the branch
wt finish: refuse excluded paths, then rebase onto origin/develop

text.tspan: wt: refusing to finish: excluded paths are staged:
feature/login is up to date with origin/develop
